title: Forget manual panning: XbotGo’s dual-lens AI camera tracks many sports games
excerpt: This article is sponsored by XbotGo
content_html:
Published Sep 28, 2026, 9:56 AM EDT

The below articles are sponsored by one of our partners. Product choices and opinions expressed are from the sponsor and do not reflect the views of the Android Police editorial staff.

Whether you’re a proud parent of a child athlete or a youth sports coach, capturing a sports game can sometimes feel impossible. You want to enjoy the moment, but wielding a camera and tracking all the major plays can feel exhausting. And even when you happen to capture that one legendary, re-watchable play, you end up feeling like you weren’t as present as you wanted to be.

Since most youth and amateur sports organizations don’t livestream their games (approximately 78%), you’re likely left to figure it out on your own. For fast-moving team sports, this is challenging, but what if you had an automated capture device?

The XbotGo Falcon is an AI sports recorder that can quickly and efficiently solve these problems, so you can capture every detail while keeping your eyes on the live game. It takes the camera operator out of the equation, so all you have to do is set it up, then sit back and watch every single play.x

An AI camera that follows the action with a dual-lens system

XbotGo Falcon

Brand
XbotGo

Up to 4K resolution

The XbotGo Falcon is an AI-powered sports camera that automatically tracks fast-moving action and records games in crisp 4K, so parents and coaches can capture every play hands-free. With dual-lens tracking, support for 10+ sports, livestreaming, and no subscription fees for core features, the Falcon makes recording and sharing sports easier than ever.
 

What makes the XbotGo Falcon unique is its integrated Dual Camera System. Two lenses perform separate jobs simultaneously for a flawless recording experience. A 106-degree wide-angle tracking lens is housed in the XbotGo Falcon; it uses AI auto-tracking and intelligent motion detection to automatically follow every movement in the game. This eliminates the need to constantly change angles, move the camera, adjust the tilt, or pan to follow a play.

The tracking lens also includes a special Follow Me feature, which automatically tracks your chosen subject, so they stay in focus in the frame at all times.

The second lens is the recording lens, which captures footage in a smooth, crystal-clear 4K resolution. When you install a microSD card, it offers enough memory to capture an entire game from start to finish. The camera supports up to 1TB of storage, so you can keep hours of game footage saved on the device.

Crisp, beautiful 4K recording easily captures high-speed, action-packed games

While fast-paced sports can be a challenge to capture clearly, the XbotGo Falcon does the heavy lifting so you don’t have to worry about blurry, un-viewable footage. Whether a player is sprinting across a soccer field, dunking a basketball, or running the bases, these high-octane moments will require absolutely no camera adjustment.

The XbotGo Falcon captures these actions in ultra-smooth 4K to preserve these moments with crisp clarity. The device supports various resolutions, from 1080p to 2K to 2.7K to 4K. Frame-by-frame looks smooth in any resolution, as they all support recording at up to 30fps. But for lightning-quick plays, with the latest firmware, it’s possible to capture film at up to 60fps in 1080p, which helps mitigate the choppiness that can make sports footage difficult to watch.

Filming plays at just the right angle is also a breeze. The device offers 360-degree rotation for a full view of the court or field and a tilt range of 160 degrees to catch high throws and low kicks. The latest firmware update also supports manual zoom in Follow Me mode, so you can quickly adjust from 1 to 3x zoom.

Effortless hands-free tracking that captures the action from over 10 sports

As a coach or a parent, you want to record every single moment of gameplay. Unfortunately, the hardest thing about sports recording is keeping up with the action. It’s so easy to miss a play that requires adjusting your camera angle or panning.

Luckily, the XbotGo Falcon handles that all automatically, so you don’t have to. While AI-powered tracking uses motion detection to follow the action in real-time, the camera won’t lose focus. A 6 TOPS AI Processor can easily handle high-speed, real-time tracking. This chipset combines with integrated target recognition, pose estimation, and trajectory prediction to intelligently predict what will happen next, keeping the lens in perfect focus, right where you need it.

The Falcon was also designed to automatically track the action across over 10 different sports, too. So, whether your kids play soccer, football, hockey, lacrosse, tennis, basketball, or another sport, after selecting your sport mode and hitting record, the camera adapts to whatever sport it sees for the best capture results.

Zone mapping captures the boundaries on a soccer field and beyond

Soccer games can especially benefit from the Zone Mapping feature. When the XbotGo Falcon is set to Soccer Mode, Zone Mapping helps determine the field boundaries and maintain recording on the field. So, rather than the camera accidentally panning to capture action on a nearby field or the cheering spectators, it won’t veer from the main subject: the game.

This feature in Soccer Mode automatically scans the field and builds a designated tracking zone, so you don’t have to manually define the boundaries. Just point the camera toward the field, and it will automatically create a zone using AI.

Through the XbotGo app, the newly launched Pro Soccer feature provides post-match tactical analysis, delivering individual player movement heat maps, key event replays, and shareable highlights within 24 hours.

Zero subscriptions, plus live-streamed games free of charge

Sometimes the cost of a sports camera can feel excessive, especially when it requires a cloud subscription or extra fees for add-ons. Ongoing subscriptions add up quickly, so you might avoid investing in a sports camera for this reason alone.

The XbotGo Falcon is different. A one-time purchase is the only fee you’ll pay to start capturing all the live sports games you want. Its core features are included, which means you can immediately take advantage of its recording, auto-tracking, and live-streaming without surprise fees or another monthly bill.

With support for local storage up to 1TB via a microSD card, parents and coaches can keep hours of footage stored locally and review match film immediately on their mobile devices without paying recurring software fees.

The XbotGo companion app is also free to use with your Falcon’s core features.

That means you can start livestreaming a game immediately, and anyone who can’t physically attend can enjoy streaming it in real time. Using the XbotGo app, you can livestream on platforms like Facebook and YouTube or other compatible services, with no streaming fees.

In the app, you can even create game highlights and save every capture to the cloud. 20GB of cloud storage is included for free, with zero subscription required.

Trade your traditional camera for an AI-powered sports camera

Coaches and proud parents of child athletes can easily record sports game footage and stay hands-free with the XbotGo Falcon AI sports camera. Whether you want to share footage with other parents, livestream for people who can’t make the game, or review practice plays, this camera offers AI-powered features to capture clear, smooth imagery, track every action, and do the hard stuff so you can watch the game without constantly fiddling with it.

Even better, the Falcon requires no subscriptions for its core features, so it’s a one-and-done purchase.

If you’re tired of recording sports footage with lackluster results and sick of viewing games through a screen, the XbotGo Falcon is now available.
